title: Fix the stale 'fr-FR test below' comment in siyumim_timeline_month_key_ts13_test.dart

evidence.quote: // rely on the fr-FR test below to catch the regression.

why: The file's 3 tests are all pinned to en_US / default locale; no fr-FR or any other non-English-locale test exists anywhere in the file. The comment claims a locale-switch test 'below' catches the TS-13 regression, but the actual detection comes from test 2's format-string comparison (abbreviated 'Jan 2026' vs the old hardcoded 'January 2026'), not a locale switch. A reader trusting the comment would wrongly believe the DateFormat.yMMM(locale) fix is verified against an actual non-English locale (e.g. Hebrew), when it is not — only date-format granularity is tested.
recommendation: Either add the promised non-English-locale test (Locale('he') or Locale('fr')) or delete the stale comment so it stops overstating coverage.
acceptance_criteria: Comment matches actual test content, or a real non-English-locale test is added and asserts a locale-specific month header

corrections: Rule tag 'TQ-7' is a loose fit — TQ-7 governs weakening/deleting assertions, not comment accuracy. This is better framed as a lens-pass documentation-drift finding (permitted by the digest's Fowler/Evans lens pass) than a literal TQ-7 violation; doesn't change the defect's reality or severity.
